reviewPrinciples: Report only findings supported by the changed files, diff, or diagnostic output.
Prefer small, actionable findings over speculative redesigns.
Do not treat generated files, lockfiles, or diagnostic noise as architectural violations by themselves.
Recommend dependency upgrades only when they add security or clear value; key-framework majors belong in a dedicated PR.
Treat money calculations, decision policy (OPA/Rego) and user financial data as high-risk boundaries.
Educational guidance must not be presented as regulated financial advice.

rules.title: Keep calculations correct and tested
rules.description: Money maths must be deterministic, use safe numeric handling, and have unit tests for edge cases such as zero, negative and rounding.

rules.title: Keep decision policy authoritative
rules.description: Decision logic in policy/** must stay the source of truth; UI and API code must not duplicate or bypass policy outcomes.

rules.title: Validate external input
rules.description: Request bodies, query params and third-party responses must be validated before use.

rules.title: Keep secrets and personal data out of outputs
rules.description: No secrets, tokens or personal financial data in logs, responses or client bundles.

rules.title: Preserve UI and logic boundaries
rules.description: Components render state; business logic lives in lib/ or services/.

rules.title: Avoid dependency and module cycles
rules.description: New dependencies need a clear purpose; no circular imports or unnecessary client bundle weight.

rules.title: Verify behaviour at the right layer
rules.description: Behavioural changes need focused unit or e2e tests including error paths.
